title: Los Alamos insider: surfaces that solid objects pass through

tellings.quote: Uh, metal surfaces were um could be manipulated to like put things through, in or out

plain: An insider at Los Alamos, the US nuclear weapons laboratory in New Mexico, is said to have described metal surfaces that could be worked so that solid things could be passed through them, in or out. Mario Woods, an Air Force veteran who speaks of being abducted, repeats this as something an unnamed insider told him, in the context of studying recovered craft. If true, it would mean the lab handles materials that behave like nothing ordinary metal can.
